claims.label: Host Says Photo Series Shows Multiple Young Men Wearing Maroon Shirts Alone in September 10 Audience
claims.claim: The host says the series of photographs she displays depicts multiple young men in maroon shirts standing alone in the Charlie Kirk event audience on September 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference photographs with attendee registration, social media, and military records to identify individuals.

claims.label: Video clip shows a man holding only a maroon shirt in the moments after the shooting
claims.claim: A video clip displayed during the episode shows a man fumbling among a group while holding a maroon shirt (not wearing it) in the moments after the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full uncirculated video footage from multiple angles to confirm and identify the individual.

claims.label: Video clip shows David Sprague standing and appearing to cheer after the shot
claims.claim: A video clip displayed during the episode shows David Sprague (James Norman Rawlinson Jr.) standing and appearing to cheer shortly after the gunshot.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the clip with public statements by Rawlinson and with the FBI interview he claims to have given.

claims.label: Video clip shows David Sprague and a companion standing under umbrellas at the event
claims.claim: A video clip displayed during the episode shows David Sprague and an unidentified companion standing together under umbrellas while Charlie Kirk's event begins.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the second individual and confirm umbrellas' purpose and provenance.

claims.label: James Rawlinson Stated on X That He Served in the 19th Special Forces and Wore a Red Beret
claims.claim: An audio clip from James Rawlinson's X account, played during the episode, contains his claim that he served in the 19th Special Forces and wore a red beret.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Rawlinson's military service record against official DoD / National Guard records.

claims.label: James Rawlinson stated on X that he has spoken to the FBI
claims.claim: The same X audio clip contains Rawlinson's statement that he has already talked to the FBI and that he hopes they are "on our side."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with FBI 302 forms, voluntary interview logs, or official acknowledgements.

claims.label: James Rawlinson stated on X that no ambulances were present at the event and the rifle sounded like a .22
claims.claim: The X audio clip contains Rawlinson's claim that there were no ambulances at an event like that and that the high-power rifle sounded like a .22.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against published video, ballistic evidence, and emergency response records.

claims.label: Article identifies Mihail Kogălniceanu air base in Constanta as a Task Force 82 / 82nd Airborne deployment location
claims.claim: The host shows an article with a photo she says was taken in 2023 at the joint base in Constanta, Romania, the Mihail Kogălniceanu air base, as part of Task Force 82 of the 82nd Airborne.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm article source, date, and unit assignment through DoD public affairs records.

claims.label: A photograph allegedly shows James Rawlinson in Romania in 2023 wearing a maroon beret
claims.claim: A photograph displayed during the episode allegedly shows James Rawlinson in Romania in 2023 wearing a maroon beret, on the right side of the photo.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm identity with Rawlinson himself, military photo archives, and contemporaneous deployment records.

claims.label: A 60 Minutes interview of former Mossad agents described Israeli operations as a "Truman Show" production
claims.claim: An audio clip from a 60 Minutes interview of former Mossad agents, played during the episode, includes the description of Israeli operations as a "global production company" running a "Truman Show" with shell companies hiding Israeli involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full 60 Minutes episode transcript and air date; verify the speakers' identities and former agency affiliation.

claims.label: Frank Turek stated on a podcast that no exit wound was visible on the back of Charlie Kirk's neck
claims.claim: A podcast audio clip of Frank Turek, played during the episode, contains his statement that he did not believe there was an exit wound on the back of Charlie Kirk's neck during the car transport.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the official autopsy report and Brian Harpole's prior podcast statements.

claims.label: Frank Turek stated on a podcast that CPR was performed on Charlie Kirk in the car
claims.claim: The same podcast audio clip of Frank Turek contains his statement that he was "sometimes doing CPR" with Charlie "a foot away."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against Brian Harpole's prior podcast statements that no CPR was performed and that the focus was on the wound.

claims.label: Host Says People With Direct Knowledge Claim Erika Kirk Ran Modeling Apartments at Next Model Management
claims.claim: During the episode, the host asserts that people with direct knowledge of Erika Kirk's involvement with Next Model Management claim she was in charge of modeling apartments for underaged models; she adds that a current class action names Next Model Management and MC2 as defendants over such apartments.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain class action complaint, defendant discovery, and corroborate host's named sources under oath.

claims.label: Pending FOIA requests filed by host's team include NSA, DHS/Secret Service/EOP, FBI, and travel logs
claims.claim: The host states the team has filed FOIA requests to the NSA (Erika emotional asset email), DHS/Secret Service/EOP (WAVES entries for Erika), FBI (Kash Patel schedule), and for FBI plane flight logs and Bradley Hansell's travel schedule September 7-10.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify FOIA request submissions via the agencies' tracking portals and any responses.

claims.label: Lance Twiggs is alleged to be the maroon-shirted individual visible in audience footage
claims.claim: During the episode, the host says she believes Lance Twiggs is the individual walking in a maroon shirt in a video that was allegedly taken the same day.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain higher-resolution frame-by-frame comparison and corroborate via independent witnesses.

claims.label: Host Believes Tyler Robinson Was Set Up by Lance Twiggs
claims.claim: During the episode, the host states her belief, based on evidence presented thus far, that Tyler Robinson did not kill Charlie Kirk and was set up by Lance Twiggs.
claims.investigative_direction: Examine public charging documents, defense filings, Robinson's alibi evidence, and Twiggs's digital footprint.

claims.label: Host Says Andrew Kolvet Appeared Live on the Charlie Kirk Show but Was in Washington D.C.
claims.claim: The host states Andrew Kolvet appeared to be live in studio on the Charlie Kirk Show hosting Kash Patel, but was actually pre-recorded and physically located 5 hours away in the Executive Office Building in Washington D.C.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Secret Service visitor logs, EEOB badge access records, and corroborate the Charlie Kirk Show production timeline.

claims.label: Host Says Army Regiments Appeared to Organize by Color in Plain Clothes
claims.claim: The host says it looked to her as if army regiments were organizing by color in plain clothes in the September 10 audience.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the maroon-shirted attendees from event footage and compare them with military rosters or unit assignments.
claims.transcript_snippet: And it did look to me like our army regiments were organizing by color, but in plain clothes.

claims.label: Host Says Viewers Emailed That Undercover Overseas Units Organize by Color
claims.claim: The host says people with military experience emailed her to say that when they operate undercover overseas they organize in that manner.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the emails and verify the senders' service records and whether the practice they describe is documented doctrine.
claims.transcript_snippet: when we do things overseas and we're being we're undercover, we do organize in that manner.

claims.label: Host Says No One Will Convince Her the Deep State Did Not Organize the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says that after the maroon-shirt findings no one will convince her that the deep state did not organize Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as a stated belief; test it against the maroon-shirt identifications and the Rawlinson service records.
claims.transcript_snippet: And no one will ever convince me that the deep state did not organize Charlie Kirk's assassination after this.

claims.label: Host Says the Audience Had Too Many Older People and Too Few Students
claims.claim: The host says she noticed immediately that the September 10 audience had far too many older people and not enough students.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare audience age data from event footage, ticketing or UVU attendance counts with the host's impression.
claims.transcript_snippet: there were way too many older people, not enough students.

claims.label: Host Says Many Attendees Wore Bright Hats and High Socks With Black Pants
claims.claim: The host says many attendees wore bright colored hats (not the ones Charlie Kirk threw out), and some boys wore high socks with black pants, and that she has these observations organized in folders.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's folders of audience stills and test whether the hat and sock patterns are statistically unusual for a campus event.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was a large presence of people that were wearing bright colored hats, not the ones that Charlie uh threw out

claims.label: Host Says UVU's School Colors Are Green and White, Not Maroon
claims.claim: The host says she first thought the maroon shirts might be school colors but that UVU's colors are green and white.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah Valley University's official brand colors and any maroon campus apparel.
claims.transcript_snippet: But nope, UVU's colors, it turns out, are green and white.

claims.label: Host Says the Man Who Supplied Footage Was Suspect and His Son Wore Maroon
claims.claim: The host says the man who gave her all the footage struck her as remarkably suspect and that his son was wearing a maroon shirt.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the footage supplier (unnamed in this episode) and corroborate the son's attire from the supplied footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: this guy who gave us all the footage, I found him to be remarkably suspect, and his son was wearing a maroon shirt.

claims.label: Host Says the Solo Maroon-Shirted Men Had Athletic Builds
claims.claim: The host says the men who were alone in maroon shirts had a particularly athletic build, which made her think they could be military.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect clear stills of each maroon-shirted man and compare them to the host's athletic-build observation; identify them independently.
claims.transcript_snippet: the men that were alone, they had a particularly athletic build.

claims.label: Host Says the Cheering Man Became a Distraction Point
claims.claim: The host says that, in retrospect, the viral story of the man who stood and cheered after the shot registers to her as a major distraction point as people began looking for clues.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace how the cheering clip was amplified (accounts, dates, reach) and whether amplification was organic.
claims.transcript_snippet: To be frank, in retrospect, it registers to me as another major distraction point.

claims.label: Host Reports the Cheering Man Said He Was Not Cheering Because Charlie Was Hurt
claims.claim: The host says the man identified as David Sprague gave an interview clarifying that he was not cheering because Charlie was hurt but was trying to push the crowd into a patriotic cheer.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Sprag's interview and compare his explanation with the clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: He came out, he did an interview clarifying that he wasn't cheering because Charlie was hurt.

claims.label: Host Says Viewers Urged Looking Into the Umbrella Boys
claims.claim: The host says viewers emailed asking her to look into the 'umbrella boys', meaning Sprague and his companion who huddled under an umbrella at the event, and that he looked 'dressed super young' but was in his 40s.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the companion and compare Sprag's stated age with public records.
claims.transcript_snippet: They who were emailing us saying you need to look into these umbrella boys.

claims.label: Host Says David Sprague's Birth Name Is James Norman Rawlinson Jr.
claims.claim: The host says David Sprague is not his original name and that his actual birth name is James Norman Rawlinson Jr.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the court name-change record and compare it with the host's report.
claims.transcript_snippet: We learned that his actual birth name is James Norman Rawlinson Jr.

claims.label: Rawlinson Told the Host He Legally Changed His Name to Separate From His Father
claims.claim: The host says Rawlinson told her in a conversation that he had legally changed his name recently because he wanted separation from his father.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the name-change petition and its filing date from the relevant court.
claims.transcript_snippet: he claimed that he had legally changed his name uh recently because he wanted separation from his father.

claims.label: Rawlinson Told the Host His Father Got in Trouble for Child Abuse
claims.claim: The host says Rawlinson claimed his father got in trouble for child abuse and that she has been completely unable to confirm this.
claims.investigative_direction: Search court and sex-offender registries for any matching record; the host reports she has found none.
claims.transcript_snippet: he claimed that his father got in trouble for child abuse, for harming children.

claims.label: Host Could Not Find Any Registered Record of the Father's Alleged Crime
claims.claim: The host says she thought it odd that she could not find, if Rawlinson's father had committed a crime, any registered record of it.
claims.investigative_direction: Search civil and military court records for the father; the host suggests an air base prosecution may not appear in ordinary searches.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can't seem to find that anywhere registered.

claims.label: Host Says Rawlinson Joined Army Boot Camp in 2011 and Joined the Utah National Guard
claims.claim: The host says Rawlinson joined Army boot camp in 2011 and was promoted to corporal or specialist at the start of 2014 in the Utah National Guard.
claims.investigative_direction: Request Rawlinson's service record (DD-214 or National Guard personnel file) to confirm enlistment and promotion dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: he joined Army boot camp in 2011. He was promoted to a corporal and/or specialist at the beginning of 2014 for the Utah National Guard.

claims.label: Host Says the 19th Special Forces Group Is Headquartered at Camp Williams, 20 Minutes From the Event
claims.claim: The host says the 19th Special Forces Group is a National Guard unit headquartered at Camp Williams in Lehi, Utah, about 20 minutes from where Charlie Kirk was murdered.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the unit's headquarters and the distance from Camp Williams to the UVU venue.
claims.transcript_snippet: Camp Williams is 20 minutes down the road from where Charlie was murdered.

claims.label: Host Says One Must Earn the Maroon Beret Before Becoming a Green Beret
claims.claim: The host says she thinks one cannot become a Green Beret in the 19th Special Forces without first receiving the maroon beret (parachutist) certification.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Army qualification pathways for Special Forces candidates with a doctrine source; the host says she is unsure she has it right.
claims.transcript_snippet: cannot be a green beret without having received the maroon beret certification.

claims.label: Host Says the 19th Special Forces Routinely Deploys to Romania
claims.claim: The host says the US Army's 19th Special Forces Airborne routinely deploys to Romania to conduct unconventional warfare and trains with Romanian special operations forces alongside NATO allies.
claims.investigative_direction: Check DoD and National Guard releases on 19th SFG rotations to Romania and their dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: the US Army's 19th Special Forces Airborne uh routinely deploy of all places to Romania to conduct unconventional warfare.

claims.label: Host Says Curtis Kolvet, Kolvet's Brother, Was in Romania the Same Year as Rawlinson
claims.claim: The host says that at the same time Rawlinson was reportedly in Romania (late 2023 into 2024), Curtis Kolvet, Andrew Kolvet's brother and, she believes, a Nevada National Guard lieutenant colonel running the military police, was also in Romania that year.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Nevada National Guard deployment orders or press releases for Lt. Col. Curtis Kolvet and the dates of his Romania service.
claims.transcript_snippet: Curtis Kolvet, Andrew Kolvet's brother, uh who was, I believe, Nevada National Guard, running the as a lieutenant colonel for the Nevada National Guard

claims.label: Host Says She Asked Rawlinson Five Times About Service in Romania and He Did Not Answer
